format: JSONL one complete path per record

weight.lo_hi: exact binary64-lifted point interval saved as decimal strings

semantics.weighted_reduction: weighted physical moment/absolute final stock intervals over complete path; not correction
semantics.cumulative_correction: unweighted cumulative continuous-minus-captured moment intervals; frozen-minus-captured plus continuous-minus-frozen
semantics.segments.DP: unweighted corrected endpoint minus captured row n; use final segment for final photon correction
semantics.segments.energy_endpoint_minus_captured_: unweighted corrected physical endpoint energy minus captured row u; erg
semantics.segments.anchor_to_next: signed physical energy seam without spectral weight; include anchored=false seams
semantics.interval: {lo,hi} decimal strings; exact rational parsing possible
